episodes.synopsis: A splinter group of rebels is trying to obtain the key to Laplace's Box. On her way to stop them, Audrey Burne meets 16-year-old Banagher Links.
episodes.title: Day of the Unicorn

episodes.synopsis: Now piloting the Unicorn Gundam, Banagher defeats the Sleeves pilot Marida and her Kshatriya, but is picked up by a Londo Bell assault ship.
episodes.title: The Second Coming of Char

episodes.synopsis: The Federation Forces launch an assault on the Sleeves stronghold of Palau to recapture Banagher and the Unicorn Gundam.
episodes.title: The Ghost of Laplace

episodes.synopsis: A Zeon remnant force launches an attack on the Earth Federation capital, but it's a feint. Marida is taken to a Federation facility in North America.
episodes.title: At the Bottom of the Gravity Well

episodes.synopsis: Banagher is beaten by the black mobile suit Banshee and taken into custody. Meanwhile, Martha wants Mineva's help to make Banagher talk.
episodes.title: The Black Unicorn

episodes.synopsis: Full Frontal and the Sleeves allow the Nahel Argama to escape the EFSF, then take over the ship. Banagher and Mineva are faced with a decision.
episodes.title: Two Worlds, Two Tomorrows

episodes.synopsis: Banagher battles Riddhe, who wants to stop him and Mineva reaching Industrial 7's Magallanica, where Laplace's Box is hidden. Marida launches to help.
episodes.title: Over the Rainbow
